Interface VehicleInterface

All Known Implementing Classes:
ElectricVehicle, Vehicle
public interface VehicleInterface
Defines the core contract and standard operations for all vehicles in the car dealership system.

  • Method Details

    • applyDiscount

      void applyDiscount(int percentage)
      Reduces the base price of the vehicle by the specified integer percentage.
      Parameters:
      percentage - The discount percentage to apply (e.g., 10 for a 10% discount)

    • getFinalPrice

      int getFinalPrice()
      Calculates and returns the final commercial selling price of the vehicle. Applies age-related depreciation, a minimum price floor, and fuel type adjustments.
      Returns:
      The final selling price in currency units

    • averageKmPerYear

      double averageKmPerYear()
      Calculates the average annual distance driven in kilometers (mileage divided by age). If the vehicle's age is 0 (new vehicle), the total mileage is returned.
      Returns:
      The average kilometers driven per year
